visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a close-up of a bamboo steamer containing six translucent soup dumplings. A pair of black chopsticks lifts one dumpling, placing it onto a white ceramic spoon, revealing juice leaking from the bottom. The background is a dimly lit, neutral-toned restaurant setting. (2) The scene shifts to another close-up where a dumpling is bitten open to reveal a vibrant purple taro filling. Small yellow captions appear at the bottom center. (3) Two male staff members, wearing light brown aprons, white caps, and surgical masks, are seen in a brightly lit kitchen area. They are manually placing dark truffle filling into thin dough wrappers using metal spatulas. (4) A rapid sequence of shots shows the dumplings being placed in steamers and then multiple steamers being set on a counter with lids being lifted to reveal swirling steam. (5) A close-up shows a dumpling being dipped into a small white bowl of dark soy sauce and ginger strips. The lighting is bright and warm. (6) The scene changes to a black frying pan where small buns are being sizzled in oil, followed by a plate of golden-brown pan-fried buns topped with sesame seeds and green onions. (7) Close-up shots of two bowls of soup—a creamy yellow corn soup and a dark brown hot and sour soup—being stirred and served. (8) A brief shot of the restaurant's empty dining area with wooden tables and black-framed chairs under a ceiling fan. (9) The final phase shows the exterior of the shop, 'Xiao Kou Chi', with a pink and white sign on a typical urban street with scooters and other building signs visible under a cloudy sky.
